translations.title: Invictus - L'invincibile
translations.overview: Le dolorose tappe del cammino che ha portato Nelson Mandela alla presidenza del Sudafrica spingendolo a collaborare col capitano della squadra nazionale di rugby, François Pienaar, per tenere unito il paese dopo l'Apartheid.
translations.tagline: Il suo popolo voleva un leader. Lui gli diede un campione.

translations.overview: Newly elected President Nelson Mandela knows his nation remains racially and economically divided in the wake of apartheid. Believing he can bring his people together through the universal language of sport, Mandela rallies South Africa's rugby union team as they make their historic run to the 1995 Rugby World Cup Championship match.
translations.tagline: His people needed a leader. He gave them a champion.
